title: Static Double Grip Drawknife
description: One newly authored complete fixed drawknife-inspired woodworking handtool. A single continuous broad straight steel-style blade narrows and returns at both ends into two parallel tangs; two whole shaped faceted hardwood grips and fixed collars form the double-handled open silhouette. The central space between returned grips remains open. This is not an old toothed handsaw, U-channel gouge or curved single-handled sickle with changed length or material. All geometry newly authored, three solid opaque constant PBR roles, metres and complete horizontal bounds-centred ground origin, one prop and zero scenes. Finite blunt blade thickness for game art only; no sharp edge, cutting or shaving performance, internal bored grip, tang tolerances, hand fit, manufacture, joint strength or safety claim. Fixed tang roots meet the solid grips as visual assembly, not a mechanical insertion certificate.
